# JWD Recipes

> > JWD Recipes offers 700+ quick and easy international food recipes for families, curated by Jon Dawson with a focus on accessible home cooking across diverse cuisines and dietary preferences.

JWD Recipes is a comprehensive recipe resource featuring international cuisine from Mediterranean, Italian, Vietnamese, Moroccan, and French traditions. The site caters to various dietary needs including keto, vegan, and vegetarian options, with specialized cooking techniques like air frying and baking.

## Key Topics

- International Cuisine

## Core Recipe Collections

- [JWD Recipes - Quick & Easy International Food Recipes for Families](https://jwdrecipes.com): Homepage showcasing 700+ international recipes from Jon Dawson
- [Food Recipes Blog - Explore 700+ International Meals](https://jwdrecipes.com/recipes): Complete recipe collection with international, keto, and dessert options

## Meal-Based Recipes

- [Breakfast](https://jwdrecipes.com/breakfast): Breakfast recipe collection including French toast and egg dishes
- [Lunch](https://jwdrecipes.com/lunch): Lunch recipes featuring Mediterranean, Vietnamese, and fusion cuisine
- [Dinner](https://jwdrecipes.com/dinner): Dinner recipes with Thai, Lebanese, and international quick meals
- [Dessert](https://jwdrecipes.com/dessert): Dessert collection with cakes, pies, and no-bake options

## Dietary & Cooking Methods

- [Keto](https://jwdrecipes.com/keto): Keto-friendly low-carb recipes with almond flour and cauliflower
- [Vegan](https://jwdrecipes.com/vegan): Vegan plant-based recipes from Moroccan, Italian, and French cuisines
- [Vegetarian](https://jwdrecipes.com/vegetarian): Vegetarian meatless meals with Mediterranean and Moroccan flavors
- [Air Fryer Recipes](https://jwdrecipes.com/air-fryer): Air fryer recipes for quick, crispy, healthy cooking techniques
- [Baking](https://jwdrecipes.com/baking): Bread and artisan baking recipes with whole grains and sourdough

## Specialty & Appetizers

- [Pizza](https://jwdrecipes.com/pizza): Pizza variations from Hawaiian to BBQ with homemade crust recipes
- [Dips](https://jwdrecipes.com/dips): Dip and appetizer recipes including jalapeño poppers and crab rangoon

## Seasonal Recipes

- [Summer Recipes](https://jwdrecipes.com/summer): Seasonal summer drinks with lemonade, mocktails, and berry beverages
- [Halloween Recipes](https://jwdrecipes.com/halloween-recipes): Seasonal Halloween pumpkin desserts and spooky party treats

## Featured Recipes

- [New York Style Cheesecake Recipe](https://jwdrecipes.com/new-york-style-cheesecake): New York cheesecake recipe with cream cheese and water bath technique
- [Vanilla Panna Cotta With Berry Sauce](https://jwdrecipes.com/vanilla-panna-cotta-with-berry-sauce): Italian panna cotta dessert recipe with berry sauce from Piedmont
- [Authentic New York-Style Bagels](https://jwdrecipes.com/authentic-new-york-style-bagels): New York bagel recipe with barley malt syrup and boiling technique
